items.title: Share these readings with your care team
items.text: You should talk to your team about your readings, which were only in the target range 0.8% of the time. Your average reading was 235.2 mg/dL, so bring this up at your next visit.

items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: You walked after meals only 2 times, which is too few to see how it affects you. Walking after dinner is linked to a rise in sugar about 18.3 mg/dL smaller in the same person.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: All of your dinners started at 8 pm or later, which is linked to sugar rising about 9.2 mg/dL more than earlier dinners. Try to start dinner before 8 pm to see how it affects you.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: You averaged an overnight fast of 9.8 hours, which is less than the 13 hours that might be beneficial. Adding an overnight fast to coaching changed HbA1c by -0.03 points in the program.
